text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: They get weak in the summer, so they want to make the whole world colder!? Don't be ridiculous, who would do that? Cats don't do well in the cold!
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏だと弱るから世界を冷たくしてやろうって！？
ふざけんじゃないわよ誰がさせるかってーの、
猫は寒さに弱いんだかんね！

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Indeed! And for the sake of the safety of Lea-san and Lady Anemone’s journey, we cannot let you pass beyond this point...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
そして、
リアさんとアネモネ様の
旅の安寧のためにも
この先をお通しするわけには参りません……！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: There's plenty of distance between us and Mone... If we manage to keep them here, we will be able to prevail over those monsters without them noticing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
モネらとの距離は十分……
此の地であらば、
二人に気取られるより早く
魔物たちを排する事も叶いましょうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Riri
text_block_list.text: Yes. I am still worried about whether the two of them have made it to their destination safely, or if they are getting along. However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
お二人が無事目的の場所へたどり着けているか、
仲良くなれているか。
どちらも
心配ではありますが……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Trust in them for now, and let's beat the crap out of these monsters! Be as quiet as possible!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今は信じて、
この魔物たちをぶっとばすわよ！
できるだけ静かにね！
